verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows skills.sh or the vercel-labs/agent-skills collection maintaining behavioral tests, evals, or regression checks for its skills. The only verification-adjacent item is the agentskills.io spec's `skills-ref validate`, which checks SKILL.md format, not skill behavior. Community comments note the leaderboard ranks by install counts rather than quality, which is consistent with but not proof of the absence of evals.
